sections.title: Core concepts
sections.digest: A concise orientation to wound healing for this question-bank chapter.

questions.stem: Which growth factor is the primary driver of fibroblast activity and collagen synthesis during wound healing?

options.why: TGF-β is the main signal driving fibroblast collagen production.
VEGF primarily drives angiogenesis, not fibroblast collagen production.
TNF-α is an inflammatory cytokine and is not the primary signal for collagen synthesis.

explanation: TGF-β stimulates fibroblasts to produce collagen and extracellular matrix.
VEGF principally supports endothelial migration and capillary growth.
keyFacts: TGF-β is important for fibroblast migration and matrix deposition.
questions.teachingPoint: TGF-β is a central cytokine in tissue fibrosis and scarring.
